categories.main_business_segments: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the renewable energy sector, focusing on wind power, solar power (including photovoltaic and solar thermal), and hydropower generation. The company also develops energy storage solutions such as pumped storage and new energy storage technologies, and invests in related strategic industries. Its business model includes development, investment, construction, operation, and market trading of renewable energy projects across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in offshore and onshore wind power, photovoltaic solar power, solar thermal power, and pumped storage hydropower. It emphasizes integrated energy systems such as source-grid-load-storage (source-grid-load-storage integration) and multi-energy complementary development. The firm also invests in smart operation and maintenance technologies, digital transformation, and innovation in energy storage and hydrogen energy technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are major state-owned power grid companies including State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as regional power companies across 23 provinces. The company serves the electricity market with a focus on renewable energy supply, green power trading, and carbon asset transactions. Its markets cover both guaranteed renewable energy purchases and market-based electricity trading segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. Key regions include Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Qinghai, Gansu, Shaanxi, Ningxia, Guangdong, Fujian, Jiangsu, Shandong, Liaoning, and others. It also has strategic projects in desert and arid regions and leads offshore wind power development in coastal provinces such as Guangdong, Fujian, and Tianjin.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Three Gorges Renewables operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain, focusing on project development, construction, operation, and electricity sales. It also engages in upstream activities through technology innovation and equipment procurement but mainly acts as a power producer and seller within the renewable energy value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes large-scale renewable energy base development, especially in desert and offshore wind power. It focuses on technological innovation in offshore wind power equipment, smart operation and maintenance, integrated energy systems, and new energy storage technologies. R&D investments exceed 700 million RMB annually, with over 1400 patent applications and 500 patents granted in 2024. It also emphasizes digital transformation and ESG integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity from wind, solar, and hydropower projects. The company participates in both guaranteed renewable energy purchase schemes and market-based electricity trading, including green power certificate trading and carbon asset transactions. Additional revenue streams include energy storage services and strategic investments in related industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Three Gorges Renewables is a leading player in China's renewable energy sector, especially in offshore wind power where it holds the largest installed capacity nationally and globally. It competes with other major renewable energy producers and equipment manufacturers such as Goldwind Technology. The company is recognized as a top-tier enterprise in the global renewable energy industry and ranks among the top 500 global new energy companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company has a total installed capacity of approximately 47.96 GW, with annual revenue of about 29.7 billion RMB, representing a 12.13% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 6.11 billion RMB, a decrease of 14.81% compared to the previous year. Total assets reached approximately 356.87 billion RMB, growing 14.44% year-over-year. The company maintains a strong cash flow and continues to invest heavily in new projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its leadership in large-scale renewable energy base development, especially in offshore wind power, with advanced technology and integrated energy solutions. It differentiates itself through its scale, technological innovation, comprehensive project management, and strong market presence across China. Its commitment to ESG principles, digital transformation, and diversified energy portfolios enhances its competitive advantage and supports sustainable growth.
